asked.item: No custom cover image option for Facebook Reels
YouTube has a thumbnail field but Facebook doesn't (is it expected)

verdict.reason: The pages state Facebook does not support custom cover images for video posts via API, and that support is set by each platform, with YouTube supported.

steps.text: Facebook does not support custom cover images for video posts via API.
You cannot set a custom thumbnail when publishing Facebook videos through Blotato or any third-party tool.
Custom thumbnail and cover support is set by each platform, not by Blotato: YouTube supports it and Facebook does not.
